# Combat systems
This section gathers the key combat mechanics of WH14K: [textlink="psyker" link="WH40KPsyker"], [textlink="morale" link="WH40KMorale"], [textlink="squads" link="WH40KSquads"], [textlink="influence" link="WH40KInfluence"], [textlink="chaplain" link="WH40KChaplain"].
Pick a subsystem for details: - [textlink="Psyker & Chaos" link="WH40KPsyker"] — the warp, disciplines, backlash, god gifts. - [textlink="Morale execution" link="WH40KMorale"] — team buff through executing an ally. - [textlink="Squads" link="WH40KSquads"] — groups of fighters under a leader. - [textlink="Influence" link="WH40KInfluence"] — capturing points on the map. - [textlink="Chaplain" link="WH40KChaplain"] — Sacred Dash and bible healing.
